newsitem.title: USA: Florida-produced exports rise 4.3 pct in 1st half.
newsitem.headline: Florida-produced exports rise 4.3 pct in 1st half.

text.p: The value of export products grown, mined or manufactured in Florida for shipment abroad rose to $12.3 billion for the first six months of 1996, a 4.3 percent increase over the first half of last year, Enterprise Florida said Friday.
Brazil was the leading country destination, receiving more than $1.1 billion of Florida-produced goods in the first half of 1996. That was an increase of 1.4 percent over the first half of last year
Florida currently leads the nation in the value of state- produced exports to Brazil, followed by Texas with $711 million and California with $562 million.

Canada was the second leading destination for Florida-produced goods, receiving $927.7 million worth, an increase of 4.8 percent over the first six months of 1996; followed by Colombia, $715 million, up 0.2 percent; Venezuela, $545.6 million, up 13.2 percent; and the Dominican Republic, $529.9 million, up 4.9 percent.

The top five Florida-origin exports by industry grouping were industrial machinery and computers, $2.5 billion, up 16.8 percent over the first half of last year; electronic equipment, $1.8 billion, up 1.3 percent; transportation equipment, $1.7 billion, up 14.1 percent; chemicals and allied products, $1.6 billion, down 7.4 percent; and instruments and related products, $800 million, up 3.1 percent.
Enterprise Florida is a public-private partnership that took over duties performed by the now-defunct Florida Department of Commerce.
